propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase should consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` and cite code-health lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-line cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as durable historical evidence.
The Discovery phase guidance must acknowledge the `unavailable` state for metrics whose signal has not yet accrued, so agents do not treat absence as zero.

docs/user-guide.md must document the `rebar metrics` command, its four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state with accruing_since/reason fields.
AGENTS.md's 'Where to read' pointer list must include a metrics reference linking to docs/user-guide.md and docs/reuse-surface.md.
docs/reuse-surface.md must reference the `rebar.metrics` registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY) for library consumers to discover the reusable surface.
